description: Selective symmetry: left-right symmetric but not top-bottom symmetric.
prompt: Write a GLSL ES 3.0 fragment shader implementing mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord). iResolution (vec3) and iTime (float) are provided; do not redeclare them and do not write main(). Requirements: (1) draw one bright magenta horizontal rectangle centered at normalized position (0.50, 0.68); (2) its full width is 0.50 and full height is 0.18 of frame height; (3) the image must be symmetric left-to-right but NOT symmetric top-to-bottom; (4) use a near-black background and hard edges; (5) remain static; (6) no NaN output.
